title: Zucchini Slice
steps: Preheat the oven to 180C (160C fan-forced). Grease a 20 x 30 cm slice tin and line it with baking paper.
Grate the zucchini and carrot. Squeeze the grated zucchini firmly in handfuls over the sink to wring out as much liquid as you can.
Finely dice the brown onion, thinly slice the spring onions and grate the cheddar cheese.
Whisk the eggs in a large bowl and season well with salt and pepper.
Add the zucchini, carrot, brown onion, spring onion, corn kernels, cheddar cheese, self-raising flour and olive oil to the eggs. Stir until just combined.
Pour the mixture into the tin and level the top with a spatula.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the top is golden and the centre springs back when pressed.
Stand in the tin for 10 minutes, then cut into squares and serve warm or cold.
